text: Heavy trucks along Dufferin Street consistently use Stonehouse Crescent as a cut-through to travel towards Queen Street West. These trucks are very large and are creating challenges in the neighbourhood. Vehicles are often blocked in, and visibility is impacted as a result of the street's width – putting all road users in unsafe situations. Transportation Services confirmed there are alternative travel routes for these trucks and that a restriction here will not impact traffic flow. Heavy trucks making deliveries to properties on Stonehouse Crescent are exempt from this regulation.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited heavy vehicles at all times on Stonehouse Crescent, between Dufferin Street and Gladstone Avenue.
